info.description: Public control-plane API v1. Every read returns an owner-supplied ReadResult. Commands return a durable Operation, a CommandRejection when they were not admitted, or a typed admission/forwarding failure when existence cannot safely be inferred; they do not synthesize state from another owner.

json-schema/v1/artifact-export-command.s.description: A request to finalize a stopped Lab virtual recorder source and export its immutable artifact. It is separate from Lab stop.
json-schema/v1/artifact-export-command.s.title: ArtifactExportCommand

json-schema/v1/artifact-manifest.schema..description: An immutable artifact identity created only after source finalization succeeds.
json-schema/v1/artifact-manifest.schema..title: ArtifactManifest

json-schema/v1/capability-document.schem.description: A Guest Runtime-preserved provider capability observation. Unsupported is explicit, not an omitted field.
json-schema/v1/capability-document.schem.title: CapabilityDocument

json-schema/v1/catalog-observation-comma.description: A request to persist an immutable Recorder self-observation projection. Catalog assigns receivedAt/persistedAt and preserves device occurredAt unchanged.
json-schema/v1/catalog-observation-comma.title: CatalogObservationIngestCommand

json-schema/v1/catalog-observation.schem.description: An immutable Guest Runtime Observation Catalog projection of a Recorder-owned self-observation. Catalog timestamps do not replace the device occurredAt fact.
json-schema/v1/catalog-observation.schem.title: CatalogObservation

json-schema/v1/clock-quality.schema.json.description: A Time Authority-owned clock quality observation. A timestamp alone is not evidence of synchronization.
json-schema/v1/clock-quality.schema.json.title: ClockQuality

json-schema/v1/command-admission-failure.description: A typed failure while admitting a command. admissionState=not-admitted proves no Operation was persisted; admissionState=unknown preserves that the caller must retry the exact requestId after the owner recovers.
json-schema/v1/command-admission-failure.title: CommandAdmissionFailure

json-schema/v1/command-rejection.schema..description: A typed command non-admission result. No Operation exists for this result. It can describe invalid input, revision conflict, or a dependency failure determined before forwarding.
json-schema/v1/command-rejection.schema..title: CommandRejection

json-schema/v1/common.schema.json.title: Runtime Platform v1 common contract definitions

json-schema/v1/deletion-receipt.schema.j.description: A Lab-owned immutable receipt that distinguishes resources deleted from Archive-owned artifacts deliberately retained by policy.
json-schema/v1/deletion-receipt.schema.j.title: DeletionReceipt

json-schema/v1/delivery-receipt.schema.j.description: One Recorder Gateway-owned upstream delivery attempt. It is separate from ingress durability and preserves an uncertain upstream outcome instead of claiming delivery success.
json-schema/v1/delivery-receipt.schema.j.title: DeliveryReceipt

json-schema/v1/export-receipt.schema.jso.description: An Archive Export-owned receipt. Upload and indexing success remain separate facts.
json-schema/v1/export-receipt.schema.jso.title: ExportReceipt

json-schema/v1/external-upstream-command.description: A revisioned command to persist and explicitly observe an ExternalUpstreamIntegration. The command carries only references, never endpoint secrets.
json-schema/v1/external-upstream-command.title: ExternalUpstreamApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/external-upstream-integra.description: A Guest Runtime-owned configuration and explicit provider observation for an external VitalServer upstream. It contains references, never endpoint secrets or provider-private state.
json-schema/v1/external-upstream-integra.title: ExternalUpstreamIntegration

json-schema/v1/external-vitalserver-deli.description: C46 Guest Product deployment-administrator configuration for one C44-selected external VitalServer packet-delivery target. It binds a declared external integration and provider identity to an explicit Socket.IO delivery endpoint. It is desired configuration, not a connection, authentication, packet-delivery, or VitalServer clinical-state observation.
json-schema/v1/external-vitalserver-deli.title: ExternalVitalServerDeliveryConfiguration

json-schema/v1/facade-forwarding-failure.description: A Host facade failure while forwarding a command to its configured Guest endpoint. It never claims that a Guest operation does or does not exist when deliveryDisposition is unknown.
json-schema/v1/facade-forwarding-failure.title: FacadeForwardingFailure

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C35 complete, immutable Release-build input for GuestArtifactCompiler. Every source is addressed below the explicit input root and identified by byte size and SHA-256. The selected builder copies the declared Guest root-storage base and derives one read-only RAW bootstrap storage image containing the Guest-visible NoCloud ISO9660 volume from C37/C38/C39/C44 and, for an external topology, C46 payload intent. It must not discover a Linux base, root partition, source directory, filesystem editor, storage role, topology, or delivery target.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationCommand

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C41 release-build source selection for atomically assembling one complete Guest Product C35 input root. sourceAbsolutePath is Host build-machine input only and must never appear in emitted C35/C34/C35 receipt. The declaration selects one Guest Product bootstrap artifact composer, one copied raw root-storage base, C44 topology deployment, an optional C46 external delivery configuration, and one generated read-only NoCloud bootstrap volume without implicit builder, source, topology, delivery target, or storage-role choice.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationInputAssemblyDeclaration

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C41 immutable evidence that one GuestArtifactCompilationInputAssemblyDeclaration produced one complete C35 input root. It proves assembled source identity and C35 command identity, not Guest image compilation, boot, systemd startup, or package installation.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationInputAssemblyReceipt

json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.description: C35 successful GuestArtifactCompiler result. It records the exact builder executable, declared input identities, and emitted C34 manifest identity. It proves compilation input/output correlation only; Guest boot and clean-Host installation require separate evidence.
json-schema/v1/guest-artifact-compilatio.title: GuestArtifactCompilationReceipt

json-schema/v1/guest-lifecycle-command.s.description: A Host Agent command for an explicitly addressed Guest provider. Revision mismatch is rejected before an operation exists.
json-schema/v1/guest-lifecycle-command.s.title: GuestLifecycleCommand

json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.description: C42 immutable release-build declaration for extracting one gzip-compressed ARM64 Linux kernel into the uncompressed Image consumed by the macOS Virtualization boot loader, copying the declared uncompressed initial ramdisk, and publishing one byte-identified whole-disk ext4 source image as the C35 root-storage source. sourceAbsolutePath is a build-machine-only input and must never appear in the receipt or emitted artifacts.
json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.title: GuestLinuxBootArtifactExtractionDeclaration

json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.description: C42 immutable evidence that a byte-identified ARM64 whole-disk ext4 image produced one uncompressed Linux Image for the macOS Virtualization boot loader, one initial ramdisk, and one root-storage artifact. It proves neither a C35 compilation, Guest boot, systemd startup, nor package installation.
json-schema/v1/guest-linux-boot-artifact.title: GuestLinuxBootArtifactExtractionReceipt

GuestRuntimeStateDirectory.description: The Guest Runtime-owned mutable state root which C40 provisions before the C38 supervisor may start the stateful Guest Runtime. C40 must verify this directory is the parent of C37 guestRuntime.stateDatabasePath.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-bootstrap-c.description: C39 desired first-Guest-boot installation for the Guest Product. It declares Guest-owned payload destinations, the Guest Runtime's mutable state directory, and the Guest-visible NoCloud filesystem identity only; it never names a Host-selected root partition, Host storage-image container, ext4 implementation, or Host-side filesystem write. Recorder Gateway archive entry-mode and symbolic-link policies are independent declarations so a consumer can distinguish permission preservation from safe link acceptance.

externalVitalServerDeliveryConfiguration.description: Optional C46 payload. C44 external-vitalserver selection makes it required during cross-document bootstrap composition; bundled topology must not install it as an unused fallback.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-bootstrap-c.title: GuestProductBootstrapConfiguration

GuestRuntimeStateDirectory.description: C39-declared mutable directory prepared by Guest cloud-init before the Guest Runtime starts. The directory is desired installation input, not runtime readiness evidence.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-bootstrap-v.description: C40 explicit plan from the Guest Product release composer to the selected NoCloud bootstrap-volume composer. The Host produces one read-only RAW storage image containing the Guest-visible CIDATA ISO9660 filesystem. Guest cloud-init owns the later root-filesystem installation. Every named bootstrap payload has exactly one declared file or archive installation; the service enable link must target the declared installed service unit. The plan makes source bytes, Guest destinations, archive operation, service-unit link, Guest Runtime state directory, storage-image format, and Guest filesystem explicit; the composer must not mount or edit a Guest root image, discover a source, or select a delivery medium from the Host.
json-schema/v1/guest-product-bootstrap-v.title: GuestProductBootstrapVolumeCompositionPlan

GuestPublicServiceVirtioSocketBridge.description: Guest Runtime transport adapter declaration for one C36 public route. It accepts the C32-declared virtio-socket port and forwards bytes to the Guest-loopback listener owned by the explicitly named C37 process; it is not a service readiness observation or NAT address declaration.

GuestRuntimeControlVirtioSocketListener.description: Guest-owned virtio-socket listener for the Host-declared Guest Runtime control bridge. It is a transport binding, not a Guest Runtime readiness observation.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-process-dep.description: C37 Guest-owned desired deployment input for the required Guest Runtime and Recorder Gateway processes. It makes every executable, listener, Guest public-service virtio bridge, durable store, C44 topology path, C46 external delivery-configuration path, retry limit, and selected diagnostic provider explicit. The Supervisor resolves a complete VitalServer packet-delivery configuration only from those explicit inputs. It is not a claim that either process started, accepted traffic, delivered a packet, or that an upstream is healthy.
json-schema/v1/guest-product-process-dep.title: GuestProductProcessDeploymentConfiguration

GuestProductSupervisorLogging.description: The declared Guest-owned evidence sinks for the process supervisor. journal+console keeps systemd history and C32 serial-console capture aligned without allowing a missing sink to be treated as silent success.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-service-man.description: C38 Guest-owned desired service-manager input for starting and supervising one GuestProductProcessSupervisor. It names the Linux service-manager unit, the supervisor executable and C37 configuration paths, explicit restart behavior, and the required diagnostic log sinks. It is not evidence that systemd installed, enabled, started, restarted, or stopped the unit, nor that the Guest Runtime or Recorder Gateway is ready.
json-schema/v1/guest-product-service-man.title: GuestProductServiceManagerDeploymentConfiguration

BundledVitalServerServiceDeployment.description: Required desired bundled service facts. The C35/C39 composer must later prove artifact installation and C37 process invocation agreement; this declaration alone never means that the service started.

ExternalVitalServerDeploymentConfigurati.description: References, never endpoint or credential material. The selected external provider configuration resolves delivery material before Gateway activation.

json-schema/v1/guest-product-vitalserver.description: C44 Guest Product release-author desired topology for Recorder Gateway VitalServer packet delivery and optional browser exposure. It selects bundled or external placement and preserves every required artifact or integration reference. It is not a connection, process, packet-delivery, or clinical-state observation.
json-schema/v1/guest-product-vitalserver.title: GuestProductVitalServerTopologyDeployment

json-schema/v1/guest-root-storage-partit.description: C43 explicit Release-build declaration that accepts one C42 whole-disk ext4 root-storage output and assembles one MBR-partitioned raw root-storage base for C39. It is neither a Guest boot observation nor a C35 compilation result.
json-schema/v1/guest-root-storage-partit.title: GuestRootStoragePartitionAssemblyDeclaration

json-schema/v1/guest-root-storage-partit.description: C43 immutable evidence that one C42 whole-disk ext4 root-storage output was copied into the explicitly declared MBR root partition. It proves neither filesystem materialization, Guest boot, C35 compilation, nor package installation.
json-schema/v1/guest-root-storage-partit.title: GuestRootStoragePartitionAssemblyReceipt

json-schema/v1/guest-runtime-control-end.description: The Host Agent-owned configured Guest Runtime Control HTTP target together with independent Platform Provider and Runtime Control transport observations.
json-schema/v1/guest-runtime-control-end.title: GuestRuntimeControlEndpoint

json-schema/v1/host-agent-deployment-con.description: C33 Host-owned deployment document for one Host Agent service instance. It supplies every runtime path, configured Guest Runtime Control endpoint, selected provider input, time/telemetry mode, and update-bootstrap mode. The service process must not derive omitted inputs from installation layout or command-line defaults.
json-schema/v1/host-agent-deployment-con.title: HostAgentDeploymentConfiguration

json-schema/v1/host-edge-proxy-deploymen.description: C36 Host-owned desired deployment input for one public HTTP/WebSocket edge proxy. Every listener, route target, request boundary, and client-identity policy is explicit. It is neither Guest readiness nor an upstream-health observation.
json-schema/v1/host-edge-proxy-deploymen.title: HostEdgeProxyDeploymentConfiguration

json-schema/v1/host-update-command.schem.description: C27 revisioned Host-owned command to admit an immutable bootstrap update envelope. The bundle reference is Host-local; it is not a browser or Guest path.
json-schema/v1/host-update-command.schem.title: HostUpdateCommand

json-schema/v1/host-update-journal.schem.description: C29 durable Host-owned update operation/recovery state. It stores C25 recovery input and stable digests, never the evolving C26 document itself.
json-schema/v1/host-update-journal.schem.title: HostUpdateJournal

ColdPathCaptureHandoff.description: Optional Recorder Gateway-owned evidence that this accepted ingress packet is retained by an explicit Recorder Cold-Path Capture. Its absence preserves the meaning of a migrated delivery-only record; it never means that an archive source was inferred.

json-schema/v1/ingress-receipt.schema.js.description: A Recorder Gateway-owned receipt that keeps transport acceptance, durable ingress-state handoff, and VitalServer delivery correlation separate.
json-schema/v1/ingress-receipt.schema.js.title: IngressReceipt

json-schema/v1/lab-commands.schema.json.description: Revisioned Guest Runtime Lab commands. hide, detach, and delete are deliberately separate operations.
json-schema/v1/lab-commands.schema.json.title: Lab commands

json-schema/v1/lab-resources.schema.json.description: Guest Runtime Lab-owned session, bed, and virtual recorder resources. origin=lab is an explicit owner fact, not a name-prefix inference.
json-schema/v1/lab-resources.schema.json.title: Lab resources

json-schema/v1/macos-guest-artifact-mani.description: C34 immutable Guest-image compiler output consumed by the macOS Host package composer. It identifies arm64 Linux boot and storage artifacts by logical role, byte size, and SHA-256; source paths are build-adapter inputs and are intentionally not part of the manifest.
json-schema/v1/macos-guest-artifact-mani.title: MacOSGuestArtifactManifest

json-schema/v1/macos-release-package-ass.description: C47 Release process desired input for one macOS product-package assembly. It selects the already-declared C41 Guest input assembly, Host artifacts, deployment documents, signing inputs, PKG output, package verification command, and a new C47 receipt destination. It does not prove that a package exists, that it installed, or that a Guest started.
json-schema/v1/macos-release-package-ass.title: MacOSReleasePackageAssemblyDeclaration

json-schema/v1/macos-release-package-ass.description: C47 immutable release-build evidence that one MacOSReleasePackageAssemblyDeclaration assembled and expanded-package-verified one declared macOS PKG. It records no build-machine source paths and does not prove signing acceptance, clean-host installation, service registration, Guest boot, Guest readiness, update, rollback, or uninstall.
json-schema/v1/macos-release-package-ass.title: MacOSReleasePackageAssemblyReceipt

GuestBootConsoleCapture.description: Host-owned append-only diagnostic output for the Guest kernel and early boot console. It is not Guest Runtime state or a lifecycle success signal.

GuestPublicServiceHostLocalHTTPBridge.description: Host-owned bridge declaration for one C36 public route. It binds one Host loopback HTTP target to one C37 Guest public-service virtio-socket listener; it does not expose a NAT Guest IP address.

GuestRuntimeControlHostLocalHTTPBridge.description: Host-owned bridge declaration that binds the Host Agent's loopback HTTP endpoint to the Guest Runtime's virtio-socket listener. The Host must not use a guessed or NAT-assigned Guest IP address for this control path.

GuestRuntimeDiskProvisioning.description: Host-owned provisioning configuration that keeps immutable C34 guest-root release bytes separate from the writable VM attachment.

guestRootDevicePath.description: Guest-visible C43 MBR root partition named explicitly by the Host boot configuration; it is not inferred from a Host disk-image path.

json-schema/v1/macos-virtual-machine-con.description: C32 Host-owned deployment configuration passed to the macOS virtual machine supervisor. It declares every Guest asset and resource identity needed to provision one persistent Guest runtime disk, construct one Apple Virtualization VM, expose Guest Runtime control, and expose declared public Guest services through Host-local HTTP-to-virtio-socket bridges. No path, network identity, boot argument, public route target, control transport, or release-to-runtime disk transition is inferred by the supervisor.
json-schema/v1/macos-virtual-machine-con.title: MacOSVirtualMachineConfiguration

json-schema/v1/operation.schema.json.description: A durable long-running workflow owned by one service.
json-schema/v1/operation.schema.json.title: Operation

json-schema/v1/outbound-relay-command.sc.description: A revisioned command to persist and explicitly observe an OutboundRelayTarget. It does not deliver business data or infer consumer processing.
json-schema/v1/outbound-relay-command.sc.title: OutboundRelayTargetApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/outbound-relay-target.sch.description: A Guest Runtime-owned integration resource for an outbound relay consumer. It is independent from RuntimeTopology and upstream provider state.
json-schema/v1/outbound-relay-target.sch.title: OutboundRelayTarget

json-schema/v1/platform-installation.sch.description: A Host Agent-owned installation resource. It describes installed release and host-managed data location; it does not claim Guest liveness or readiness.
json-schema/v1/platform-installation.sch.title: PlatformInstallation

json-schema/v1/platform-provider-lifecyc.description: A Host-owned C21 invocation envelope for the explicitly selected Platform Provider. Host owns durable request-id and endpoint-revision idempotency; the provider receives and validates those values without creating a second lifecycle ledger.
json-schema/v1/platform-provider-lifecyc.title: PlatformProviderLifecycleInvocation

json-schema/v1/product-update-specificat.description: C26 evolving, next-updater-only layer specification. It is authenticated by the C25 digest but is intentionally not interpreted by the previously installed Host updater.
json-schema/v1/product-update-specificat.title: ProductUpdateSpecification

json-schema/v1/provider-installation-evi.description: Platform-provider-owned evidence for the selected VM and Host service integration. It reports component facts independently and is not an installation-success inference by Host or UI.
json-schema/v1/provider-installation-evi.title: ProviderInstallationEvidence

json-schema/v1/provider-lifecycle-reques.description: A Host Agent-to-provider effect request. The provider receives only an explicit action and does not own Host workflow transitions.
json-schema/v1/provider-lifecycle-reques.title: ProviderLifecycleRequest

json-schema/v1/provider-lifecycle-result.description: An adapter-supplied live provider observation after a requested lifecycle effect. It is not Guest Runtime readiness.
json-schema/v1/provider-lifecycle-result.title: ProviderLifecycleResult

json-schema/v1/read-result.schema.json.description: An explicit owner read outcome. Consumers must not infer an available value from any other state.
json-schema/v1/read-result.schema.json.title: ReadResult

json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.description: An idempotent command to finalize one explicitly identified Recorder Gateway cold-path capture at one expected resource revision.
json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.title: RecorderColdPathCaptureFinalizationCommand

json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.description: Recorder Gateway evidence that one cold-path capture has been finalized into a digest-addressed raw packet sequence. This receipt does not claim .vital formation, artifact upload, or upstream indexing success.
json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.title: RecorderColdPathCaptureFinalizationReceipt

json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.description: A Recorder Gateway-owned non-admission result for a cold-path capture finalization command. requestId is absent when no valid command identity was supplied; the Gateway never invents one.
json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.title: RecorderColdPathCaptureFinalizationRejection

json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.description: A Recorder Gateway-owned capture aggregate for raw accepted Recorder packets. It is source evidence for a later Archive Export operation, not a .vital artifact, upload, or index receipt.
json-schema/v1/recorder-cold-path-captur.title: RecorderColdPathCapture

json-schema/v1/recorder-observation-enve.description: A Vital Recorder-owned self-observation. Gateway and Catalog may add received or persisted timestamps but must not overwrite occurredAt.
json-schema/v1/recorder-observation-enve.title: RecorderObservationEnvelope

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-plan.sch.description: A release-process-owned declaration of one intended installer artifact, platform-specific installer identity, its required Host service registrations, and every proof required before it may be called releasable. It is a plan, not evidence that an artifact exists or installed successfully.

macOSInstallerPackageIdentifier.description: The macOS pkgbuild package identifier that a macOS release installer must realize. It is release identity, not a Host Agent installation identifier.

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-plan.sch.title: ReleaseDeliveryPlan

ObservedInstallerArtifact.description: A clean-host runner observation of the exact installer artifact used for this proof stage. It is an observed identity, not C23 desired release input.

ObservedMacOSInstallerReceipt.description: A clean macOS Host observation that the C23-owned PKG receipt is installed after the explicit installer effect.

json-schema/v1/release-delivery-proof.sc.description: Release-process-owned proof records for declared delivery plans. A pending, unsupported, or failed stage never represents installation success. Every verified stage records the observed installer artifact identity so it cannot prove a different release. A verified service-registration record must also name each observed required Host service registration explicitly.
json-schema/v1/release-delivery-proof.sc.title: ReleaseDeliveryProofSet

json-schema/v1/runtime-topology-apply-co.description: A command accepted only when the explicit expected resource revision matches the owner state.
json-schema/v1/runtime-topology-apply-co.title: ApplyRuntimeTopologyCommand

json-schema/v1/runtime-topology.schema.j.description: A Guest Runtime-owned topology resource. Spec is requested configuration; status is explicit observed provider state.
json-schema/v1/runtime-topology.schema.j.title: RuntimeTopology

json-schema/v1/service-readiness.schema..description: A service-owned readiness observation. It is not synthesized from another service's process or logs.
json-schema/v1/service-readiness.schema..title: ServiceReadiness

json-schema/v1/staged-update-handoff.sch.description: C31 durable Host-local queue item. The deployment supervisor resolves invocationRelativePath under the Host-owned staging root, then passes the original C30 document to the staged next updater.
json-schema/v1/staged-update-handoff.sch.title: StagedUpdateHandoff

json-schema/v1/staged-update-invocation..description: C30 Host-to-next-updater local handoff document. The Host writes it only after C29 is durably handoff-pending, atomically stages the bundle, and records the exact request and handoff journal revision that the next updater must present with C27 completion. Host atomically verifies that handoff revision, marks execution applying, and settles C28. The next updater locates and validates opaque C26 itself; C26 is not embedded or decoded by the current Host updater.
json-schema/v1/staged-update-invocation..title: StagedUpdateInvocation

json-schema/v1/telemetry-correlation.sch.description: A safe correlation envelope for OpenTelemetry logs, metrics, and traces. It is diagnostic evidence, not product state.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-correlation.sch.title: TelemetryCorrelation

json-schema/v1/telemetry-emission-receip.description: A diagnostic-only receipt for a redacted, bounded telemetry emission attempt. It contains key names and outcomes, never untrusted attribute values.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-emission-receip.title: TelemetryEmissionReceipt

json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline-comman.description: A revisioned request to apply a node-local OTLP telemetry pipeline declaration.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline-comman.title: TelemetryPipelineApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline.schema.description: A node-local OpenTelemetry/OTLP diagnostic pipeline. Its health is not product domain state or proof of another operation outcome.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-pipeline.schema.title: TelemetryPipeline

json-schema/v1/telemetry-signal-command..description: A diagnostic signal emission request. Attribute values are input to policy only and are never persisted in a TelemetryEmissionReceipt.
json-schema/v1/telemetry-signal-command..title: TelemetrySignalEmitCommand

json-schema/v1/time-authority-command.sc.description: A revisioned request to apply a node-local NTP profile and obtain an explicit ClockQuality observation.
json-schema/v1/time-authority-command.sc.title: TimeAuthorityApplyCommand

json-schema/v1/time-authority.schema.jso.description: A node-local Time Authority resource. Each Host or Guest owns only its own NTP profile and ClockQuality observation.
json-schema/v1/time-authority.schema.jso.title: TimeAuthority

json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-envelope.description: C25 immutable, signed bootstrap contract. The currently installed Host updater verifies and stages only this compact envelope and its next-updater artifact. It deliberately has no minimumUpdaterVersion field: every release carries a compatible bootstrap envelope and a signed next updater that parses the opaque product specification.
json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-envelope.title: UpdateBootstrapEnvelope

json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-receipt..description: C27 typed Host-native bootstrap verification and staging result. Staged is only a handoff precondition, never update success.
json-schema/v1/update-bootstrap-receipt..title: UpdateBootstrapReceipt

json-schema/v1/update-completion-command.description: C27 Host-local command from the staged next updater. The expected journal revision prevents a superseded updater process from settling recovery state it no longer owns.
json-schema/v1/update-completion-command.title: UpdateCompletionCommand

json-schema/v1/update-execution-report.s.description: C28 next-updater-owned execution evidence. Host validates stable bootstrap correlation, declared order, and typed layer/rollback outcomes; it does not reinterpret the product specification.
json-schema/v1/update-execution-report.s.title: UpdateExecutionReport
